Details 
 Nocona western buckle is full of color. It features a detailed Indian chief skull motif in the center of a rectangle buckle. There is an antique gold and copper floral scroll design around the motif with turquoise stones on the sides for a touch of western flair. The buckle is surrounded by a traditional rope and starburst dot trim for an authentic cowboy look. 
- Nocona Buckle
- Antique Silver
- Measures 3 x 4
- Rectangle
- Indian Chief Skull Motif
- Floral Scroll Design
- Turquoise Stones
- Starburst Dot Edging
